description: This file defines Prometheus metrics for the Kubernetes workqueue, including metrics like depth, adds, latency, work duration, unfinished work, longest running processor, and retries. It registers these metrics and provides a provider implementation for creating metric instances.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Registers all metrics with the legacy registry and sets the workqueue provider to an instance of prometheusMetricsProvider.

methods.name: NewDepthMetric
methods.description: Creates a new gauge metric for workqueue depth with the specified name.

methods.name: NewAddsMetric
methods.description: Creates a new counter metric for workqueue adds with the specified name.

methods.name: NewLatencyMetric
methods.description: Creates a new histogram metric for queue latency with the specified name.

methods.name: NewWorkDurationMetric
methods.description: Creates a new histogram metric for work duration with the specified name.

methods.name: NewUnfinishedWorkSecondsMetric
methods.description: Creates a new gauge metric for unfinished work seconds with the specified name.

methods.name: NewLongestRunningProcessorSecondsMetric
methods.description: Creates a new gauge metric for the longest running processor with the specified name.

methods.name: NewRetriesMetric
methods.description: Creates a new counter metric for retries with the specified name.
